_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb; OpenSource/CanvasEditor/mirror.json documents the schema). This folder is the source of truth and the mirror repo is a generated, read-only copy, so PRs happen here and never there. THE MIRROR ROOT IS THE PACKAGE ROOT: `include` is folder-relative, so Package.swift lands at the repository root, which is the only place SPM resolves a package from (P·d). `vendor` grafts the shared AI corpus in at conformance/ai, which is the second path OpenSource/AI/conformance/run.ts already probes, so `node conformance/run.ts ai` runs standalone in the published repo with no monorepo checkout (the CanvasEditor jse pattern). `check` runs on the Linux mirror lane before anything is pushed and deliberately carries no Swift step: the lane is not pinned to a mac, and a check that cannot pass on the machine that runs it is worse than no check. Swift proof rides the mac lanes. `tag_from` is the bare VERSION file, so the package's one semver cuts the v<version> tag with no second place to bump. Copying bindings/ brings gradle's build/ and .gradle/ output along into the temporary stage, but bindings/kotlin-jvm/.gitignore rides with it and `git add -A` honors it, so none of that is ever committed to the mirror. Do not 'fix' that by narrowing the include list.
